summary_en: Kakaku.com's board confirmed it supports the MBO by Kamgras 1 K.K. at 3,683 yen per share, revised from 3,682 yen on October 28, 2026. The offer period has been extended to November 12, 2026, totaling 125 business days. The board stated it would continue discussions with both Kamgras and a competing bidder (Bain Capital and LINE Yahoo proposing 3,700–3,720 yen) to determine which transaction better serves shareholders.
title_en: Notice of Partial Amendment to 'Notice of Expression of Support Opinion and Recommendation to Apply for Tender Offer for Our Company's Shares and Stock Acquisition Rights by Kamgras 1 K.K.'
translation_en_brief:
On October 28, 2026, Kakaku.com disclosed an amendment to its statement of support for the MBO (management buyout) by Kamgras 1 K.K. The bidder revised the tender offer price to 3,683 yen per share, a marginal increase from 3,682 yen announced on October 14. Concurrent with this price adjustment, the tender offer period has been extended through November 12, 2026, for a total of 125 business days. The original offer period was scheduled to end October 28, 2026.

The company's board and special committee noted a competing bid from a consortium of Bain Capital and LINE Yahoo, which proposed prices of 3,700 yen (or 3,720 yen if Bain Capital succeeds in securing a non-tendering agreement with KDDI Corporation) per share on October 26, 2026. As the two bids are mutually exclusive, the board stated it will continue candid discussions with both the Kamgras bidder and the Bain/LINE Yahoo consortium to evaluate which transaction would better serve corporate value and shareholder interests, taking into account the feasibility of closing each transaction.

The board confirmed that its prior endorsement of the Kamgras offer, issued July 2, 2026, remains unchanged and that shareholders retain full discretion whether to tender their shares. The disclosure reflects the fluid nature of the bidding process as the company weighs competing proposals.
